sections.code:
ANNOLUX_API_KEY='<paste your key here>'
curl -X POST https://api.annolux.com/api/v1/search \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ANNOLUX_API_KEY}" \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"query":"rust ownership","domains":["doc.rust-lang.org"],"deduplicate":true,"limit":5,"timeout":10}'

paragraphs.en: query is required. domains is optional. deduplicate defaults to true. limit is 1–10. timeout is 1–30 seconds. ranking may be default or provider. freshness, content enrichment, Verify, Extract, trust, Answer, and Watch are unsupported in the commercial endpoint.
paragraphs.zh: query 必填；domains 可选；deduplicate 默认 true；limit 为 1–10；timeout 为 1–30 秒；ranking 仅可为 default 或 provider。商业端点不支持 freshness、内容增强、Verify、Extract、trust、Answer 与 Watch。

description.en: Frozen blind evaluation results and methodology for the Annolux bilingual index.
description.zh: Annolux 双语索引的冻结盲测结果与方法。

paragraphs.en: The frozen v2 blind set contains 40 queries. Hit@1 is 77.5%, Hit@3 is 87.5%, Hit@10 is 92.5%, and MRR@10 is 0.834375, at client p95 213 ms with zero request errors. The immutable first gate recorded Hit@10 85.0% at p95 532 ms; the improvement came from index work — exact-duplicate removal and a tiered discovery layer — while the ranking files stayed byte-identical and the blind set was never used for tuning. These figures are a small product benchmark, not a claim of web-wide superiority.
paragraphs.zh: 冻结的 v2 盲集包含 40 条查询：Hit@1 77.5%、Hit@3 87.5%、Hit@10 92.5%、MRR@10 0.834375，客户端 p95 为 213 ms，请求错误为 0。不可变的首次发布门记录为 Hit@10 85.0%、p95 532 ms；提升来自索引侧的工作——同正文去重与分层发现层——排序文件逐字节未改，盲集也从未用于调参。这是小规模产品基准，不代表全网领先。

bullets.en: The blind set is not used to tune ranking weights.
bullets.zh: 盲集不参与排序权重调参。

bullets.en: A release must not regress the stored baseline and must keep p95 at or below one second.
bullets.zh: 发布不得低于已存基线，p95 必须不高于 1 秒。

bullets.en: Failures are reviewed as alias, better answer, content gap, or ranking error before collection or tuning.

paragraphs.en: Data is used to provide accounts and Search, prevent abuse, measure credits, secure the service, support users, comply with law, and—only after live billing—administer payments. Usage, ledger, transaction, refund, tax, and dispute records may be retained longer where fraud, accounting, or law requires.

Removed profile data can remain in encrypted backups until those backups age out. Identity and fraud checks may be required before action.
paragraphs.zh: 适用时，你可通过 privacy@annolux.com 请求访问、更正、关闭、删除、限制、可携带或反对处理。关闭账户会撤销 Session 与密钥、删除在线 OAuth 资料字段，仅保留防止重复领取奖励所需的 HMAC tombstone 及依法必须保留的记录。已删除资料可能在加密备份自然到期前仍存在；执行前可能需要身份与反欺诈核验。

title.en: Web search MCP server for AI agents
title.zh: 面向 AI Agent 的 MCP 联网搜索

description.en: Add one bounded web search tool to any MCP client: search_web queries a curated English and Chinese index and returns source-attributed results with fetched_at. Not realtime, not the whole web.
description.zh: 在任何 MCP 客户端加入一个有界的联网搜索工具:search_web 查询精选中英索引,返回带来源归属和 fetched_at 的结果。非实时,非全网。

heading.en: One tool, the standard Search contract
heading.zh: 一个工具,同一套 Search 契约

paragraphs.en: annolux-mcp registers exactly one tool: search_web. Its inputs match the commercial REST endpoint, and every result carries a title, URL, snippet when available, and an explicit fetched_at timestamp. The server does not expose scraping, extraction, verification, or any hidden enrichment, so an agent cannot buy a different operation through MCP than the one documented here.
paragraphs.zh: annolux-mcp 只注册一个工具:search_web。它的输入与商业 REST 端点一致,每条结果都带标题、URL、可用时的摘要,以及明确的 fetched_at 抓取时间。服务器不暴露抓取、正文提取、验证或任何隐藏增强,Agent 通过 MCP 得到的操作与本页文档完全一致。

paragraphs.en: The index behind it is curated and bilingual (English and Chinese), refreshed on a schedule. It is not a realtime feed and it does not claim whole-web coverage; an empty result set is a normal outcome, not an error.
paragraphs.zh: 背后是精选的中英双语索引,按计划刷新。它不是实时数据流,也不声称全网覆盖;空结果是正常返回,不是错误。

paragraphs.en: The server is a single static Go binary. With a Go toolchain installed, one command builds and installs it into $(go env GOPATH)/bin — make sure that directory is on your PATH, or reference the binary by absolute path in client configs.
paragraphs.zh: 服务器是一个静态 Go 二进制。装有 Go 工具链时,一条命令即可构建并安装到 $(go env GOPATH)/bin —— 请确认该目录在 PATH 里,或在客户端配置中使用绝对路径。

heading.zh: 配置任意 MCP 客户端

paragraphs.en: Every MCP client accepts the same shape: a command plus two environment variables. The key lives only in the server process environment; annolux-mcp sends it in the Authorization header and never places it in tool results or model-visible arguments.
paragraphs.zh: 所有 MCP 客户端接受同一形状的配置:一个命令加两个环境变量。密钥只存在于服务器进程环境;annolux-mcp 仅将其放入 Authorization 请求头,不会写进工具结果或模型可见参数。

bullets.en: query — required, up to 500 characters.
bullets.zh: query —— 必填,最长 500 字符。

bullets.en: domains — optional hostname allow-list, up to 20 entries.
bullets.zh: domains —— 可选主机名白名单,最多 20 项。

bullets.en: deduplicate — defaults to true.
bullets.zh: deduplicate —— 默认 true。

bullets.en: limit — 1 to 10 results, default 10.
bullets.zh: limit —— 返回 1–10 条,默认 10。

bullets.en: timeout — 1 to 30 seconds, default 30.
bullets.zh: timeout —— 1–30 秒,默认 30。

bullets.en: ranking — default or provider.
bullets.zh: ranking —— default 或 provider。

bullets.en: freshness is not supported and is rejected explicitly.
bullets.zh: 不支持 freshness,发送会被明确拒绝。

paragraphs.en: An illustrative response. Keep fetched_at beside any citation your agent produces, so downstream readers know when the page was retrieved.
paragraphs.zh: 示例响应。请把 fetched_at 与 Agent 产出的引用放在一起,让下游读者知道页面是何时抓取的。

paragraphs.en: Only a successful 2xx Search commits one credit. Validation errors, authentication failures, insufficient balance, rate limits, server errors, and timeouts commit zero. Read X-Annolux-Credits-Used and X-Annolux-Credits-Remaining from the response instead of estimating locally. Every account gets 1,000 free credits each month.
paragraphs.zh: 只有成功的 2xx Search 提交 1 点。参数错误、认证失败、余额不足、限流、服务端错误和超时都不扣点。请读取响应头 X-Annolux-Credits-Used 与 X-Annolux-Credits-Remaining,而不是本地估算。每个账户每月 1,000 免费点数。

paragraphs.en: Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Cursor, Windsurf, Cline, and Zed each have a copy-paste page in the documentation menu, including file locations and the pitfalls that client is known for.
paragraphs.zh: Claude Code、Claude Desktop、Cursor、Windsurf、Cline 与 Zed 的可复制配置都在文档目录里，含配置文件位置和各客户端特有的坑。

title.en: Claude Code web search MCP setup
title.zh: Claude Code 联网搜索 MCP 配置

description.en: One command adds the search_web tool to Claude Code: bounded search over a curated English and Chinese index, with fetched_at on every result.
description.zh: 一条命令给 Claude Code 加上 search_web 工具:基于精选中英索引的有界搜索,每条结果带 fetched_at。

paragraphs.en: Install the annolux-mcp binary first (see MCP in the documentation menu), then register it from your terminal. Replace the key placeholder with a real key from your account.
paragraphs.zh: 先安装 annolux-mcp 二进制(见文档目录中的 MCP),然后在终端注册。把占位密钥换成你账户里的真实密钥。

sections.code: claude mcp add annolux --env ANNOLUX_API_URL=https://api.annolux.com --env ANNOLUX_API_KEY=ann_live_REPLACE_ME -- annolux-mcp

label.zh: MCP 总览与服务器安装

bullets.en: local (default) — this project on this machine only.
bullets.zh: local(默认)—— 仅本机本项目。

bullets.en: --scope project — writes .mcp.json in the repo so teammates share the server definition.
bullets.zh: --scope project —— 在仓库写入 .mcp.json,团队共享服务器定义。

bullets.en: --scope user — available in all your projects on this machine.
bullets.zh: --scope user —— 本机所有项目可用。

paragraphs.en: Never commit a raw key. In a shared .mcp.json, reference an environment variable instead — Claude Code expands ${ANNOLUX_API_KEY} from each developer's own environment.
paragraphs.zh: 不要提交明文密钥。共享的 .mcp.json 里应引用环境变量 —— Claude Code 会从每位开发者自己的环境展开 ${ANNOLUX_API_KEY}。

paragraphs.en: Run claude mcp list to confirm the server is registered, or type /mcp inside a session to see its status and the search_web tool. Then ask Claude to search something specific — for example, restrict results with a domains allow-list — and to cite fetched_at next to any link it uses.
paragraphs.zh: 运行 claude mcp list 确认服务器已注册,或在会话内输入 /mcp 查看状态和 search_web 工具。然后让 Claude 搜一个具体问题 —— 例如用 domains 白名单限定站点 —— 并要求它在引用链接旁标注 fetched_at。

paragraphs.en: The same registration also applies to non-interactive runs with claude -p, so scripted agents call the identical bounded tool with no extra setup.
paragraphs.zh: 同一注册对 claude -p 的非交互运行同样生效,脚本化 Agent 无需额外配置即可调用同一个有界工具。

heading.en: Behavior your agent can rely on

bullets.en: Only a successful 2xx search costs a credit; errors and timeouts cost zero.
bullets.zh: 只有成功的 2xx 搜索扣 1 点;错误和超时不扣点。

bullets.en: An empty result set is a normal outcome — handle it, don't retry blindly.
bullets.zh: 空结果是正常返回 —— 应当处理,而不是盲目重试。

bullets.en: freshness is rejected as unsupported; the index is curated and refreshed on a schedule, not realtime.
bullets.zh: freshness 会被明确拒绝;索引为精选、按计划刷新,非实时。

bullets.en: limit is capped at 10 and timeout at 30 seconds.
bullets.zh: limit 上限 10,timeout 上限 30 秒。

paragraphs.en: To update the server, rerun go install with @latest — the registration itself does not change. To unregister, remove it from the same scope you added it to; run claude mcp list first if you are not sure which scope holds it.
paragraphs.zh: 更新服务器只需重跑 go install @latest —— 注册信息本身不变。取消注册要在添加时的同一作用域移除;不确定在哪个作用域时,先运行 claude mcp list 查看。

title.en: Claude Desktop web search MCP setup
title.zh: Claude Desktop 联网搜索 MCP 配置

description.en: Give Claude Desktop a bounded web search tool: edit claude_desktop_config.json, restart fully, and search_web appears with fetched_at on every result.
description.zh: 给 Claude Desktop 加上有界联网搜索:编辑 claude_desktop_config.json,完全重启后即可使用 search_web,每条结果带 fetched_at。

bullets.en: macOS: ~/Library/Application Support/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json
bullets.zh: macOS:~/Library/Application Support/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json

bullets.en: Windows: %APPDATA%\Claude\claude_desktop_config.json
bullets.zh: Windows:%APPDATA%\Claude\claude_desktop_config.json

bullets.en: Or open it from the app: Settings → Developer → Edit Config.
bullets.zh: 也可从应用内打开:Settings → Developer → Edit Config。

paragraphs.en: Install the annolux-mcp binary first (see MCP in the documentation menu), then add this block. Replace the key placeholder with a real key.
paragraphs.zh: 先安装 annolux-mcp 二进制(见文档目录中的 MCP),再加入这段配置。把占位密钥换成真实密钥。

label.zh: MCP 总览与服务器安装

paragraphs.en: GUI apps on macOS do not inherit your shell PATH. If the tool never appears, replace "annolux-mcp" in the command field with the absolute path — run `which annolux-mcp` in your terminal to find it, typically $HOME/go/bin/annolux-mcp.
paragraphs.zh: macOS 的图形应用不继承你 shell 的 PATH。如果工具一直不出现,把 command 字段的 "annolux-mcp" 换成绝对路径 —— 在终端运行 which annolux-mcp 查看,通常是 $HOME/go/bin/annolux-mcp。

paragraphs.en: Claude Desktop reads the config at startup. Quit the app fully — Quit from the menu bar on macOS or the tray icon on Windows, not just closing the window — then reopen it. search_web should appear in the tools menu of a new conversation.
paragraphs.zh: Claude Desktop 只在启动时读取配置。请完全退出应用 —— macOS 从菜单栏 Quit,Windows 从托盘退出,而不是只关窗口 —— 再重新打开。新对话的工具菜单里应出现 search_web。

heading.en: If it does not show up

bullets.en: macOS logs: ~/Library/Logs/Claude/ — look at the mcp*.log files.
bullets.zh: macOS 日志:~/Library/Logs/Claude/ —— 查看 mcp*.log。

bullets.en: Windows logs: %APPDATA%\Claude\logs.
bullets.zh: Windows 日志:%APPDATA%\Claude\logs。

bullets.en: Test the server standalone: set the two env vars in a terminal and run annolux-mcp — it should start and wait on stdio.
bullets.zh: 单独测试服务器:在终端设置两个环境变量后运行 annolux-mcp —— 应正常启动并在 stdio 等待。

bullets.en: JSON syntax errors make the whole file silently ignored — validate after editing.
bullets.zh: JSON 语法错误会导致整份配置被静默忽略 —— 编辑后请校验。

paragraphs.en: To update, rerun go install with @latest — the config file needs no change. To remove, delete the annolux entry from mcpServers and restart fully. Other MCP servers in the same file are unaffected; the file stays valid as long as the JSON does.
paragraphs.zh: 更新只需重跑 go install @latest —— 配置文件无需改动。移除则从 mcpServers 删除 annolux 条目并完全重启。同一文件里的其他 MCP 服务器不受影响;只要 JSON 合法,配置就有效。

paragraphs.en: search_web queries a curated English and Chinese index — not realtime, not the whole web; an empty result is a normal outcome. Only a successful 2xx search costs one credit; errors and timeouts cost zero. Every account gets 1,000 free credits each month.
paragraphs.zh: search_web 查询精选中英索引 —— 非实时、非全网;空结果是正常返回。只有成功的 2xx 搜索扣 1 点,错误和超时不扣。每个账户每月 1,000 免费点数。

title.zh: Cursor 联网搜索 MCP 配置

description.en: Add the search_web tool to Cursor's agent: one JSON file, a curated English and Chinese index, and fetched_at on every result.
description.zh: 给 Cursor 的 Agent 加上 search_web 工具:一个 JSON 文件,精选中英索引,每条结果带 fetched_at。

bullets.en: .cursor/mcp.json — this repository only; commit it to share the server definition (not the key).
bullets.zh: .cursor/mcp.json —— 仅当前仓库;可提交以共享服务器定义(不含密钥)。

bullets.en: ~/.cursor/mcp.json — every project on this machine.
bullets.zh: ~/.cursor/mcp.json —— 本机所有项目。

paragraphs.en: Install the annolux-mcp binary first (see MCP in the documentation menu), then add this block. Replace the key placeholder with a real key.
paragraphs.zh: 先安装 annolux-mcp 二进制(见文档目录中的 MCP),再加入这段配置。把占位密钥换成真实密钥。

label.zh: MCP 总览与服务器安装

paragraphs.en: Open Cursor Settings → MCP: the annolux server should be listed with search_web as its tool; toggle it on if needed. In Agent mode the model calls the tool on its own; by default each call asks for your approval before it runs, so you always see the query being sent.
paragraphs.zh: 打开 Cursor Settings → MCP:列表中应出现 annolux 服务器及其 search_web 工具,未启用则打开开关。Agent 模式下模型会自行调用工具;默认每次调用前都请求你批准,因此你始终能看到即将发出的查询。

heading.en: A concrete ask that works well

paragraphs.en: Try: "What is the current way to define props with TypeScript in Vue? Search with domains limited to vuejs.org." The agent sends one search_web call, gets ranked results from the official docs with fetched_at on each, opens the right page, and answers with a citation you can check. One successful call, one credit.
paragraphs.zh: 试试:「Vue 里用 TypeScript 定义 props 现在的正确写法是什么?用 domains 限定 vuejs.org 搜索。」Agent 会发起一次 search_web 调用,得到来自官方文档、各带 fetched_at 的排序结果,打开正确页面,并给出可核查的引用。一次成功调用,一点。

heading.en: Point it at documentation you trust
heading.zh: 限定在你信任的文档站

paragraphs.en: The domains allow-list is the most useful field in an editor workflow: ask the agent to search with domains restricted to the library's own documentation site, and results stay inside the family you trust. Keep fetched_at next to any citation the agent writes into your code or notes.
paragraphs.zh: 在编辑器工作流里,domains 白名单是最有用的字段:让 Agent 把搜索限定在类库官方文档站,结果就不会跑出你信任的范围。Agent 写进代码或笔记的引用旁,请保留 fetched_at。

bullets.en: Binary not found: use the absolute path from `which annolux-mcp` in the command field.
bullets.zh: 找不到二进制:把 command 换成 which annolux-mcp 得到的绝对路径。

bullets.en: Edited the JSON but nothing changed: refresh the server list in Settings → MCP or restart Cursor.
bullets.zh: 改了 JSON 没生效:在 Settings → MCP 刷新服务器列表,或重启 Cursor。

bullets.en: Empty results are a normal outcome of a curated index — not an error to retry.
bullets.zh: 空结果是精选索引的正常返回 —— 不是需要重试的错误。

paragraphs.en: search_web queries a curated English and Chinese index — not realtime, not the whole web. Only a successful 2xx search costs one credit; errors and timeouts cost zero. Every account gets 1,000 free credits each month.
paragraphs.zh: search_web 查询精选中英索引 —— 非实时、非全网。只有成功的 2xx 搜索扣 1 点,错误和超时不扣。每个账户每月 1,000 免费点数。

description.zh: 给 Windsurf Cascade 加上 search_web 工具:一个 JSON 文件,精选中英索引,每条结果带明确抓取时间。

import os

from langchain_core.tools import tool

def annolux_search(query: str, limit: int = 10) -> str:

    api_key = os.environ.get("ANNOLUX_API_KEY", "")

        headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {api_key}"},

title.zh: 如何冻结一套双语 Search 评测

description.en: Why targets, dev review, and a blind set must stay separate when tuning search.
description.zh: 为什么搜索调优必须分离目标、dev 审标与盲集。

heading.en: The problem with a perfect tuning score

paragraphs.en: A short evaluation becomes misleading as soon as ranking rules are edited against every miss. Annolux separates reviewed development cases from a frozen blind set so a release number can still falsify our assumptions. A miss is first adjudicated as a target alias, a better answer, a true content gap, or a real ranking error; only the development pool may influence implementation.
paragraphs.zh: 一旦针对每个 miss 修改排序规则，小评测集就会失真。Annolux 将人工审标的 dev 用例与冻结盲集分开，让发布数字仍能证伪我们的假设。每个 miss 先被审为目标别名、更优答案、真实内容缺口或真正排序错误；只有 dev 池能影响实现。

heading.en: Freeze the corpus before reading the score

paragraphs.en: The v2 corpus contains 100 target-retrieval queries: 60 development and 40 held-out. It covers 79 English, 17 Chinese, and 4 mixed-language cases; 78 technical, 15 reference, 4 news-intent, and 3 release-intent cases. The manifest pins the exact JSONL digest, split sizes, tags, request limit, and interpretation of relevance grades.
paragraphs.zh: v2 语料含 100 条目标检索查询：60 条 dev、40 条 held-out；其中英文 79 条、中文 17 条、中英混合 4 条，并覆盖 78 条技术、15 条参考、4 条新闻意图与 3 条发布意图。manifest 固定 JSONL 摘要、分组规模、标签、请求 limit 与相关性等级解释。

paragraphs.en: A release run records the corpus and manifest hashes, code commit, evaluator commit, immutable image digest, index page and language counts, database and WAL size, timestamps, and one result row per query. Artifacts are created with an exclusive write and mode 0600, so a later run cannot silently replace the baseline. A separate ranking lock hashes the source files that implement local ordering.
paragraphs.zh: 发布运行会记录 corpus 与 manifest 哈希、代码和评测器提交、不可变镜像摘要、索引页数与语言数、数据库及 WAL 大小、时间戳和每条查询结果。产物以独占写入和 0600 权限创建，后续运行不能静默覆盖基线；独立 ranking lock 还会哈希本地排序实现源码。

paragraphs.en: On the frozen 40-query held-out split, the recorded baseline had zero request errors, Hit@1 72.5%, Hit@3 82.5%, Hit@10 85.0%, MRR@10 0.78125, and client p95 latency 532 ms. A later no-tuning prelaunch rerun reproduced the retrieval metrics with client p95 356 ms and zero request errors. These are finite target-retrieval measurements for one 251k-page index. Unlisted results are unjudged—not automatically irrelevant—and the numbers are not a claim of whole-web recall.
paragraphs.zh: 在冻结的 40 条 held-out 集上，记录基线为请求错误 0、Hit@1 72.5%、Hit@3 82.5%、Hit@10 85.0%、MRR@10 0.78125、客户端 p95 延迟 532ms。后来一次未调参的上线前重跑复现了相同检索指标，客户端 p95 为 356ms，请求错误为 0。这只是一个 25.1 万页索引上的有限目标检索测量；未列出的结果是“未审标”，不自动等于不相关，也不代表全网召回。

heading.en: How the release gate is used

paragraphs.en: Before traffic moves, Annolux reruns v2 only as a regression check: no result may be used to tune the frozen weights. The release gate requires zero errors, Hit@3 at least 65%, Hit@10 at least 80%, MRR@10 at least 0.55, and p95 no more than one second. If it fails, the held-out set becomes diagnostic evidence; a new blind set must be authored before ranking can be accepted again.
paragraphs.zh: 切流前，Annolux 只把 v2 重跑作为回归检查，任何结果都不得用于调整冻结权重。发布门要求错误为 0、Hit@3≥65%、Hit@10≥80%、MRR@10≥0.55、p95≤1 秒。若失败，held-out 集转为诊断证据；再次接受新排序前必须另建盲集。

title.en: A search result is not evidence

description.en: The boundary between finding a page and proving what it said at a point in time.
description.zh: 找到页面与证明它在某时说过什么之间的边界。

heading.zh: 检索回答的是更窄的问题

paragraphs.en: Search ranks pages that may answer a query. It does not prove that a claim is true, that the page is unchanged, or that every relevant source was found. A high score describes the relationship between query terms, document text, and local ranking features; it is not a statement about publisher authority or factual correctness.
paragraphs.zh: Search 排出可能回答查询的页面，但不证明观点为真、页面未变或已找到全部相关来源。高分只描述查询词、文档文本和本地排序特征之间的关系，不代表发布者权威或事实正确。

heading.en: Four ways a useful result can still fail as evidence
heading.zh: 有用结果仍可能无法成为证据的四种方式

bullets.en: The publisher can edit or remove the page after it was indexed.
bullets.zh: 发布者可在索引后修改或删除页面。

bullets.en: A snippet can omit qualifiers, dates, jurisdiction, or surrounding context.
bullets.zh: 摘要可能省略限定条件、日期、司法辖区或上下文。

bullets.en: A page can accurately report that someone made a claim without proving the claim.
bullets.zh: 页面可能准确记录某人提出了主张，却并未证明主张。

bullets.en: A focused index can miss a primary source even when the returned pages look plausible.
bullets.zh: 精选索引即使返回看似合理的页面，也可能漏掉一手来源。

heading.en: Use fetched_at as a boundary, not a guarantee
heading.zh: 把 fetched_at 当作边界，而不是保证

paragraphs.en: Every standard Search result exposes fetched_at. It tells an agent when Annolux last fetched the indexed page and makes staleness observable. It does not say that the live URL still has the same bytes, that all page assets were captured, or that the statement was true at fetch time. Freshness filters are rejected as unsupported rather than silently ignored because this index is periodically refreshed, not realtime.
paragraphs.zh: 每个标准 Search 结果都公开 fetched_at，说明 Annolux 上次抓取该索引页的时间，使陈旧程度可见。它不表示在线 URL 仍是相同字节、不表示抓全所有资源，也不表示抓取当时的陈述为真。由于索引是周期刷新而非实时系统，freshness 过滤会被明确拒绝，不会静默忽略。

paragraphs.en: Invite-only Labs may retain a bounded observation, content digest, timestamps, source metadata, and a signed receipt for a specific workflow. That can help prove what the system observed and how it processed the observation; it still does not convert third-party content into truth. Labs is an experiment, not a hidden Pro or Scale entitlement, and standard results never receive a verified label merely because they ranked well.
paragraphs.zh: 邀请制 Labs 可为特定工作流保留有界观察、内容摘要、时间戳、来源元数据和签名回执。它能帮助证明系统观察到什么、如何处理该观察，却仍不能把第三方内容变成事实。Labs 是实验，不是 Pro 或 Scale 的隐藏权益；标准结果不会因排名靠前就获得“已验证”标签。

heading.zh: 更安全的 Agent 模式

paragraphs.en: Use Search to discover candidate sources, prefer primary documents, compare fetched_at with the decision horizon, fetch the live source when permitted, preserve the exact passage and URL used, and require independent review for medical, legal, financial, or safety-critical claims. Retrieval is the beginning of an evidence workflow, not its final verdict.
paragraphs.zh: 先用 Search 发现候选来源，优先一手文档；将 fetched_at 与决策时效比较；在允许时读取在线来源；保留实际使用的原文与 URL；医疗、法律、财务或安全关键主张必须独立复核。检索是证据工作流的起点，不是最终裁决。

title.en: Operating a bilingual index on one VPS
title.zh: 在一台 VPS 上运行双语索引

description.en: The practical boundaries behind a 251k-page English and Chinese search index.
description.zh: 25.1 万页中英搜索索引背后的工程边界。

paragraphs.en: The index uses SQLite WAL, separate English and Chinese FTS streams, compressed bodies, per-domain fairness, robots controls, and content admission. The current snapshot contains about 251,368 pages: 215,485 English and 35,883 Chinese. Annolux describes that scope directly instead of implying realtime, global-web coverage.
paragraphs.zh: 索引使用 SQLite WAL、分离的英文与中文 FTS、压缩正文、按域公平、robots 控制与内容准入。当前快照约 251,368 页，其中英文 215,485、中文 35,883。Annolux 直接说明这一范围，不暗示实时或全球全网覆盖。

heading.zh: 一个数据库，两套文本系统

paragraphs.en: English and Chinese documents share durable page metadata while indexing into language-specific FTS tables. English token normalization and Chinese segmentation are tested independently, then a frozen, bounded ranking pass combines lexical coverage, URL shape, and BM25 rather than sending an unbounded candidate set to a remote model. There is no GPU reranker in the launch path.
paragraphs.zh: 中英文文档共享持久页面元数据，但进入各自语言的 FTS 表。英文 token 归一与中文分词独立测试，再由冻结且有界的排序阶段组合词汇覆盖、URL 形态与 BM25；不会把无限候选送到远程模型，首发路径也没有 GPU 重排器。

heading.en: Fair crawling is a resource-control problem
heading.zh: 公平抓取也是资源控制问题

paragraphs.en: The internal indexer respects robots decisions, leases work fairly across domains, filters locale and path traps before admission, bounds response bodies, and checkpoints SQLite rather than letting WAL grow without limit. Before opening the database and before each lease, it stops when disk usage reaches 82% or free space falls below 25 GiB. A stop is clean and leaves no leased frontier rows behind.
paragraphs.zh: 内部索引器遵守 robots 决策，按域公平租约，在准入前过滤 locale 与路径陷阱，限制响应正文，并让 SQLite checkpoint 而不是让 WAL 无限增长。打开数据库前及每次租约前，只要磁盘使用达到 82% 或空余低于 25GiB 就会停止；停止过程干净，不留下被占用的 frontier 行。

paragraphs.en: Routine maintenance conditionally fetches only known URLs. The refresh mode cannot lease pending discovery work, insert a new frontier URL, or follow links into breadth-first expansion. The remaining pending frontier is not migrated into an automatic job. New URLs enter only after a fresh blind set or real-user adjudication demonstrates a content gap.
paragraphs.zh: 日常维护只条件请求已知 URL。刷新模式不能租用待发现任务、不能插入新 frontier URL，也不会沿链接进行广度扩张；现有 pending frontier 不会迁入自动任务。只有新盲集或真实用户审标证明内容缺口后，新 URL 才会进入。

heading.zh: 用复制让回滚变得无聊

paragraphs.en: A deployment copies the checkpointed index into a separate directory; it never moves or overwrites the previous data. Before and after copying, an operator checks file size, SHA-256, SQLite integrity, English and Chinese FTS document counts, page totals, and WAL state. The new API starts on a spare loopback port and the old containers keep their data until public Search and tunnel rollback drills pass.
paragraphs.zh: 部署会把已 checkpoint 的索引复制到独立目录，绝不移动或覆盖旧数据。复制前后检查文件大小、SHA-256、SQLite integrity、中英文 FTS 文档数、总页数和 WAL 状态。新 API 先在备用 loopback 端口启动，旧容器保留数据，直到公网 Search 与隧道回滚演练通过。

title.en: Agent quickstart with Search and MCP
title.zh: 使用 Search 与 MCP 接入 Agent

description.en: Use the same bounded standard Search contract over REST or the search_web MCP tool.
description.zh: 通过 REST 或 search_web MCP 工具使用同一套有界标准 Search 契约。

paragraphs.en: annolux-mcp registers one tool: search_web. Its inputs match the commercial REST endpoint—query, domains, deduplicate, limit up to 10, timeout up to 30, and default/provider ranking. It does not expose Verify, Extract, trust, a crawler, or hidden enrichment, so an agent cannot accidentally buy a different operation through MCP.
paragraphs.zh: annolux-mcp 只注册 search_web。输入与商业 REST 端点一致：query、domains、deduplicate、limit≤10、timeout≤30，以及 default/provider 排序；不暴露 Verify、Extract、trust、爬虫或隐藏增强，因此 Agent 不会通过 MCP 意外购买另一种操作。

paragraphs.en: Send a bearer key to POST /api/v1/search. domains is an optional hostname allow-list, deduplicate defaults to true, and the response returns ranked title, URL, snippet, score when available, and fetched_at. The server owns X-Request-ID; clients cannot reuse it to replay a previously committed credit reservation.
paragraphs.zh: 把 Bearer Key 发送到 POST /api/v1/search。domains 是可选主机名白名单，deduplicate 默认 true；响应返回排序后的标题、URL、摘要、可用时的 score 与 fetched_at。X-Request-ID 由服务端生成，客户端不能复用它重放已提交的点数预占。

heading.en: Make credit behavior part of the agent loop
heading.zh: 把点数语义纳入 Agent 循环

paragraphs.en: Only a successful 2xx standard Search commits one credit. Validation errors, authentication failures, insufficient balance, rate limits, server errors, and timeouts commit zero. Read X-Annolux-Credits-Used and X-Annolux-Credits-Remaining instead of estimating locally. A 402 means stop or ask the user to obtain a new grant; there is no surprise overage charge.
paragraphs.zh: 只有成功的 2xx 标准 Search 提交 1 点。参数错误、认证失败、余额不足、限流、服务端错误和超时都不提交点数。应读取 X-Annolux-Credits-Used 与 X-Annolux-Credits-Remaining，而不是本地估算。402 表示停止或请用户获取新点数，不会产生意外超额费用。

heading.en: Keep the key out of prompts
heading.zh: 不要把密钥放进提示词

paragraphs.en: Configure ANNOLUX_API_KEY in the MCP process environment. The MCP client sends it only in the Authorization header and never places it in tool results or model-visible arguments. Use a separately named key per runtime, copy the raw value once, revoke it when a machine is lost, and never paste it into an issue or support message.
paragraphs.zh: 在 MCP 进程环境中配置 ANNOLUX_API_KEY。MCP 客户端只将其放进 Authorization 请求头，不写入工具结果或模型可见参数。每个运行环境使用独立命名密钥；原始值只复制一次；设备丢失时立即撤销；不要粘贴到 Issue 或支持邮件。

paragraphs.en: Use domains when the agent knows the documentation family it needs, retain fetched_at beside citations, and handle an empty result as a normal outcome. Do not send freshness because the hosted index rejects it as unsupported. For realtime news or exhaustive discovery, choose a source designed for that job rather than hiding the mismatch behind retries.
paragraphs.zh: 当 Agent 知道所需文档域时使用 domains，把 fetched_at 与引用一起保留，并把空结果当作正常结果处理。不要发送 freshness，因为托管索引会明确拒绝该选项。若需要实时新闻或穷尽发现，应选择为该任务设计的数据源，而不是用重试掩盖能力不匹配。
